post.hook: DeepSeek takes aim at Claude Code
post.subhook: Plus ChatGPT exploits, LLM-driven malware and OpenAI's funding gap

stories.headline: DeepSeek open-sources a coding agent aimed at Claude Code
stories.detail: The research prototype is a proactive agent that can monitor group chats for coding issues.

stories.headline: ChatGPT accounts taken over via artifact sandbox exploit
stories.detail: Parameter Labs describe a flaw in ChatGPT's sandboxed HTML previews that could compromise user accounts.

stories.headline: Anthropic bars Claude from cloning and reverse-engineering games
stories.detail: Reporting says the restrictions also catch legitimate developers and basic troubleshooting tasks.

stories.headline: Volta-Autodoxer malware uses LLMs to rank victims
stories.detail: The infostealer uses AI tools to collect and rank victim data, including credentials and payment details.

stories.headline: OpenAI raises about $11B against a $30B target
stories.detail: The shortfall is being read as a sign that major investors are pulling back from AI funding.

stories.headline: Claude Duet research preview opens to US Pro, Max and Ultra
stories.detail: Eligible US subscribers on those plans can now try Claude Duet.

stories.headline: Claude Cowork arrives on mobile and web
stories.detail: Anthropic widens where users can run its Cowork agent product.

stories.headline: Deepgram acquires Daily, maker of Pipecat
stories.detail: Voice AI consolidates as Deepgram buys the company behind the open-source Pipecat framework.

stories.headline: ChatGPT share-link bug could run attacker code
stories.detail: Opening a malicious share link could run attacker code in the viewer's logged-in ChatGPT session.

post.caption:
DeepSeek has open-sourced a coding agent pitched squarely at Claude Code, and ChatGPT had a rough day on security.

1. DeepSeek releases a research prototype of a proactive coding agent that can monitor group chats for coding issues (Techmeme)
2. Claude Duet research preview opens to eligible US Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers (TechMyMoney)
3. Claude Cowork comes to mobile and web (Mashable)
4. Parameter Labs describe taking over ChatGPT accounts through its sandboxed HTML previews (Simon Willison)
5. Anthropic restricts Claude from cloning and reverse-engineering video games, and reporting says legitimate developers are caught too (Tom's Hardware)
6. The Volta-Autodoxer infostealer uses AI tools to collect and rank victim data, including credentials and payment details (Wired)
7. OpenAI raises about $11B of a $30B target, a shortfall read as investors pulling back (TechCrunch)
8. Deepgram acquires Daily, the company behind the open-source Pipecat voice framework (Techmeme)
9. A ChatGPT share-link bug could run attacker code in a viewer's logged-in session (Techmeme)

Be careful which ChatGPT links you open today. 🔒
